notes:
The 1915 edition of Henderson Guide shows Miss A. Zelmer, an employee of Paulin Chambers, and living at 692 Atlantic Ave. After Stanley died, Addey and Stan first moved from Arlington Street to an Apartment building at 417 St. John's Ave. The three picutres on this file are of this building.  They occupied Suite # 1. Stanley passed away and from there, she moved to Luther Home on Leila because she needed care.

Did not have any children.
